name: Gotarrendura (Spain)
description: Yellow field patterned as a wall of white-jointed bricks, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gotarrendura (ears of wheat, a quill and a cross on red).
history: Municipal flag of Gotarrendura; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gotarrendura arms — ears, quill and cross on red
